# Harrison

[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Harrison is short, fat, and bald. He has a round face and prominent blue eyes, and is known to present a neat and snug appearance.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Harrison is considered an odd person, having earned a reputation as a crank, and describes himself as a crusty, lonesome, crabbed old chap. He prides himself on being remarkably outspoken, though he is also known to be an awful kind man who shows outward sympathy and feels deep empathy for the plight of his animals. Additionally, he appears to hold a prejudice against marriage.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), +2 more_

## History

Before settling in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mr. Harrison lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), and had visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy. He had also received his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), from his dying brother. After moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he confronted his new neighbor, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), when her cow strayed into his oat field, but the two later formed an unexpected friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold his cow and confessed to the mistake. Over time, Harrison routinely shared debates and visits with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though he refused to contribute to her Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). His parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) was later killed during a devastating hail storm that struck the area. Shortly after, Harrison's long-estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and reunited with him, after which Harrison explained to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that their past separation had been caused by arguments over household neatness, grammar, and his late parrot.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), +27 more_

## Quotes

> "Sorry, miss! Sorry isn’t going to help matters any. You’d better go and look at the havoc that animal has made in my oats . . . trampled them from center to circumference, miss."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> “Who? Mrs. Lynde? Don’t you tell me I’m like that old gossip,” said Mr. Harrison irritably. “I’m not . . . not a bit. What have you got in that box?”
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

> "I see you haven’t much confidence in my ability to make tea. You’re wrong . . . I can brew up as good a jorum of tea as you ever drank. But go ahead yourself. Fortunately it rained last Sunday, so there’s plenty of clean dishes."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P34](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0034)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when he angrily confronted her over her cow invading his oatfield. Their connection shifted into an unexpected friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold Harrison's cow and went to his house with tea, cake, and the money to confess. Since then, they have become friendly neighbors who visit, trade confidences, and debate local topics such as village hall projects and teaching methods, even though Harrison occasionally refuses her requests or doubts her plans.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +25 more_

- Friend of — friendly neighbors who visit and confide in each other  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), +1 more</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--rachel-lynde.md)

Harrison and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) share a mutual, strong dislike and outspoken hostility toward one another. Harrison frequently debates Mrs. Lynde's virtues during his visits with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), +1 more_
